metadata.question: Does the snow cover extent in the Tinguiririca basin (specifically -34.752733, -70.647985) on December 18, 2023, exceed the average snow cover observed on December 18 from 2017 to 2022?

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-70.647985, -34.752733]);
  let basinSource = 'HydroBASINS L06';
  let region = ee.FeatureCollection('WWF/HydroSHEDS/v1/Basins/hybas_lev06')
    .filterBounds(pt)
    .first()
    .geometry();
  // Fallback if basin not found
  region = ee.Algorithms.If(region, region, pt.buffer(20000).bounds());
  region = ee.Geometry(region);

  // Helpers
  function maskModisSnow(img) {
    const snow = img.select('NDSI_Snow_Cover');
    const valid = snow.gte(0).and(snow.lte(100));
    return snow.updateMask(valid);
  }
  function buildCollection(dateStart, dateEnd, datasetVersion) {
    const terraId = datasetVersion === '061' ? 'MODIS/061/MOD10A1' : 'MODIS/006/MOD10A1';
    const aquaId  = datasetVersion === '061' ? 'MODIS/061/MYD10A1' : 'MODIS/006/MYD10A1';
    const terra = ee.ImageCollection(terraId).filterBounds(region).filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd);
    const aqua  = ee.ImageCollection(aquaId).filterBounds(region).filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd);
    return {terra, aqua};
  }
  function mosaicMasked(col) {
    return col.sort('system:time_start').map(maskModisSnow).mosaic();
  }
  async function getInfoAsync(obj) {
    return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => obj.getInfo(resolve));
  }
  async function summarize(dateStr) {
    // Try strategies: exact day (1-day window) then 3-day window; datasets 061 then 006.
    const date = ee.Date(dateStr + 'T00:00:00');
    const windows = [
      {start: date, end: date.advance(1, 'day'), winDesc: '1d'},
      {start: date.advance(-1, 'day'), end: date.advance(2, 'day'), winDesc: '3d'}
    ];
    const datasets = ['061', '006'];
    let triedImagesExist = false;
    for (let d = 0; d < datasets.length; d++) {
      for (let w = 0; w < windows.length; w++) {
        const ds = datasets[d];
        const win = windows[w];
        const col = buildCollection(win.start, win.end, ds);
        const sizeTer = ee.Number(col.terra.size());
        const sizeAqu = ee.Number(col.aqua.size());
        const sizeTotal = sizeTer.add(sizeAqu);
        const st = await getInfoAsync(sizeTotal);
        if (st > 0) {
          triedImagesExist = true;
          const mosaic = mosaicMasked(col.terra.merge(col.aqua));
          const stats = mosaic.reduceRegion({
            reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}),
            geometry: region,
            scale: 1000,
            maxPixels: 1e9,
            bestEffort: true
          });
          const mean = await getInfoAsync(ee.Number(stats.get('NDSI_Snow_Cover_mean')));
          const count = await getInfoAsync(ee.Number(stats.get('NDSI_Snow_Cover_count')));
          if (count && count > 0 && mean !== null) {
            return {mean: mean, count: count, imgs: st, win: win.winDesc, ds: ds};
          }
          // if count==0 or mean null, try next fallback
        }
      }
    }
    return {mean: null, count: 0, imgs: triedImagesExist ? -1 : 0, win: 'NA', ds: 'NA'};
  }

  // Basin source note (if HydroBASINS missing)
  const basinExists = await getInfoAsync(ee.Algorithms.IsEqual(
    region.equals(pt.buffer(20000).bounds()), false
  ));
  if (!basinExists) basinSource = 'Fallback buffer 20km';

  console.log('Basin:', basinSource);

  // 2. Baseline (2017-2022) per-year summaries
  const years = [2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022];
  let baselineMeans = [];
  let baselineImagesExist = 0;
  let baselineHadNoValidPixels = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < years.length; i++) {
    const y = years[i];
    const sum = await summarize(y + '-12-18');
    if (sum.imgs > 0) baselineImagesExist += 1;
    if (sum.count > 0 && sum.mean !== null && sum.mean >= 0 && sum.mean <= 100) {
      baselineMeans.push(sum.mean);
      console.log(y + ': imgs=' + sum.imgs + ', win=' + sum.win + ', valPx=' + sum.count + ', mean=' + sum.mean.toFixed(1));
    } else {
      if (sum.imgs === 0) {
        console.log(y + ': imgs=0');
      } else if (sum.imgs === -1) {
        baselineHadNoValidPixels += 1;
        console.log(y + ': imgs>0 but 0 valid pixels');
      } else {
        console.log(y + ': imgs=NA');
      }
    }
  }

  if (baselineImagesExist === 0) {
    console.log('Baseline: no images found 2017-2022.');
    console.log('C1');
    return;
  }
  if (baselineMeans.length === 0) {
    console.log('Baseline: images exist but 0 valid pixels after masking for all years.');
    console.log('C2');
    return;
  }
  const baselineMean = baselineMeans.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / baselineMeans.length;
  console.log('Baseline used: ' + baselineMeans.length + '/6, mean=' + baselineMean.toFixed(1));

  // 3. Target date 2023-12-18
  const t2023 = await summarize('2023-12-18');
  if (t2023.imgs === 0) {
    console.log('2023: imgs=0');
    console.log('C1');
    return;
  }
  if (!(t2023.count > 0)) {
    console.log('2023: imgs>0 but 0 valid pixels');
    console.log('C2');
    return;
  }
  if (t2023.mean === null || t2023.mean < 0 || t2023.mean > 100) {
    console.log('2023: invalid mean');
    console.log('C3');
    return;
  }
  console.log('2023-12-18: imgs=' + t2023.imgs + ', win=' + t2023.win + ', valPx=' + t2023.count + ', mean=' + t2023.mean.toFixed(1));

  // 4. Comparison and final answer
  console.log('Comparison: 2023=' + t2023.mean.toFixed(1) + ' vs baseline=' + baselineMean.toFixed(1));
  if (t2023.mean > baselineMean) {
    console.log('A');
  } else {
    console.log('B');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}
```
